value: The cortico-collicular pathway is silent or weak at rest, so it only alters collicular responses when it is actively driven, which is why suppression produces no effect while activation does.

value: Active feedback suppresses the strongly driven responses at the receptive-field centre while boosting weakly driven responses, flattening the tuning curve and shrinking the STRF.
